notes.title: 'WISH-Paradise High' Launch Anniversary Event!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40213622/d795d855a0d78665039cf497650e496e9a56f4c1.jpg

'WISH-Paradise High' Launch Anniversary Event!

Collaboration between illustrator Kidmo and WISH's developer MMTGAMES!

Thank you for loving 'WISH-Paradise High'.

We have received advice from many people since the launch of 'WISH-Paradise High'.
MMTGAMES organized an event to repay the support of these users.

Please leave comments on 'WISH-Paradise High' that you want to improve.

We will try to get your opinions and complete it with a better game.

We will select 10 people who gave us valuable opinions and give you a 10 dollar Steam Gift Card.  

Thanks to your interest and encouragement.

Thank you.

- Event name : 'WISH-Paradise High Launching Commemoration'
- Event product : 10 people selected $10 Steam Gift Card
- Event Period : May 1st - May 10th, 2021
- Event announcement : May 11th AM 10:00 PST

P.S. 

We would like to tell you a few things because there was not enough prior notice before and after the release.

- WISH-Paradise High is a collaborative game through an official contract with illustrator KIDMO.
- 'WISH-Paradise High' has a total of 10 heroes. Currently, 5 characters can play and will be updated sequentially.
- System improvements and bugs in the game are currently being prepared to be fixed and updated. We apologize for the inconvenience caused by the game.
